name: OpenClaw
author: team@cyra.systems
description: OpenClaw — multi-channel agent gateway + CLI. Bridges chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mattermost, Zalo, Twitch) to LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama) and tools. This egg clones the upstream repo, installs pnpm + Bun build deps, builds the runtime bundle, auto-generates a gateway token, and writes a per-deployment openclaw.json with Control UI allowedOrigins derived from the allocation (SERVER_IP + SERVER_PORT) and the customer's public subdomain so the gateway is reachable from the browser on first boot.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Upstream Git URL to clone. Override to deploy a fork or private mirror.

variables.name: Git Ref (Branch / Tag / SHA)
variables.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out during install / reinstall.

variables.name: Gateway Bind Mode
variables.description: Where the gateway listens. 'loopback' = 127.0.0.1, 'lan' = 0.0.0.0 (reachable via Wings port mapping). Use 'lan' for normal panel usage.

variables.name: Public Hostname (subdomain)
variables.description: Customer-facing FQDN that fronts this deployment (e.g. customer1.openclaw.example.com). The installer seeds Control UI allowedOrigins so the browser can reach the gateway via this hostname without the 'origin not allowed' error. Leave blank if you only access via IP:PORT.

variables.name: Public Scheme
variables.description: Scheme for the public hostname. Use 'https' when a reverse proxy terminates TLS, 'http' otherwise.

variables.name: Extra Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional full origins (scheme://host[:port]) to append to gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins. Useful for staff tools, staging domains, or a wildcard '*' on trusted LANs.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Token
variables.description: Bearer token required to call the gateway. Leave blank to auto-generate on first install (stored in ~/.openclaw/.env). Generate manually with: openssl rand -hex 32. Required when binding beyond loopback.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Password (alt)
variables.description: Optional alternative to the token-based auth. Use either a token OR a password, not both.

variables.name: Allow Insecure Private WS
variables.description: Set to 1 to allow the gateway's private WebSocket on plaintext (non-TLS). Leave empty in production.

variables.name: State Directory Override
variables.description: Optional override for the OpenClaw state directory. Defaults to ~/.openclaw inside the container.

variables.name: Config Path Override
variables.description: Optional override path for openclaw.json. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.

variables.name: Load Shell Env
variables.description: Set to 1 to import missing keys from the login shell profile at startup.

variables.name: Shell Env Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Milliseconds to wait when sourcing the login shell profile for env vars.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone for log timestamps inside the container.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenAI.

variables.name: Anthropic API Key
variables.description: API key for Anthropic (Claude).

variables.name: Gemini API Key
variables.description: API key for Google Gemini / AI Studio.

variables.name: Google API Key
variables.description: API key for Google (alias used by some Gemini flows).

variables.name: OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenRouter.

variables.name: Groq API Key
variables.description: API key for Groq.

variables.name: Ollama API Key
variables.description: API key for a local/remote Ollama instance. Use 'ollama-local' for a local daemon with no auth.

variables.name: Z.AI API Key
variables.description: API key for Z.AI.

variables.name: AI Gateway API Key
variables.description: API key for a Vercel-compatible AI gateway.

variables.name: MiniMax API Key
variables.description: API key for MiniMax.

variables.name: Synthetic API Key
variables.description: API key for the Synthetic provider.

variables.name: OpenAI Live Key
variables.description: Dedicated key for OpenAI live/realtime flows.

variables.name: Anthropic Live Key
variables.description: Dedicated key for Anthropic live/realtime flows.

variables.name: Gemini Live Key
variables.description: Dedicated key for Gemini live/realtime flows.

variables.name: OpenAI API Keys (pool)
variables.description: Comma-separated pool of OpenAI keys for round-robin / quota spreading.

variables.name: Anthropic API Keys (pool)
variables.description: Comma-separated pool of Anthropic keys.

variables.name: Gemini API Keys (pool)
variables.description: Comma-separated pool of Gemini keys.

variables.name: Telegram Bot Token
variables.description: Token for the Telegram channel. Format: 123456:ABC-DEF...

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Token for the Discord channel.

variables.name: Slack Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token (xoxb-...) for the Slack channel.

variables.name: Slack App Token
variables.description: App-level token (xapp-...) for Slack Socket Mode.

variables.name: Mattermost Bot Token
variables.description: Access token for the Mattermost channel.

variables.name: Mattermost URL
variables.description: Base URL of the Mattermost server (e.g. https://chat.example.com).

variables.name: Zalo Bot Token
variables.description: Token for the Zalo channel.

variables.name: Twitch Access Token
variables.description: OAuth token for the Twitch channel (e.g. oauth:...).

variables.name: Brave Search API Key
variables.description: API key for the Brave Search tool.

variables.name: Perplexity API Key
variables.description: API key for the Perplexity tool (pplx-...).

variables.name: Firecrawl API Key
variables.description: API key for the Firecrawl tool.

variables.name: ElevenLabs API Key
variables.description: API key for ElevenLabs voice synthesis.

variables.name: ElevenLabs API Key (XI alias)
variables.description: Alias env var some SDKs expect for ElevenLabs (XI_API_KEY). Usually identical to ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

variables.name: Deepgram API Key
variables.description: API key for Deepgram speech-to-text.

variables.name: Claude.ai Session Key
variables.description: Session key for the optional Claude.ai web provider.

variables.name: Claude Web Session Key
variables.description: Alternate session key for the Claude web provider.

variables.name: Claude Web Cookie
variables.description: Raw cookie string for the Claude web provider (alternative to session key).
